transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to see me?

Um... well, I guess I'm just having a hard time keeping my work in order lately. I work in dry cleaning, and... things just keep getting piled up. Tickets, the receipts, customer jobs, notes... it all just ends up mixed together. I just... I look at it and I don't know what to handle first anymore. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you struggled with staying organized like this throughout your life, including as a child, or is this a new problem for you?

I suppose it's not really new. It's... always been a bit of a struggle, I guess. Even back in grade school... my teachers used to tell my mother I was bright, but just... scattered. I was always talking out of turn, or losing my papers. They always had to remind me to finish my work. So... yeah. Not new.
Nowadays, do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or having trouble sitting still?

I don't know... maybe a little? I mean, I guess I'm on my feet a lot at work anyway, so I don't really think about it much. I don't think I'm bouncing off the walls or anything. Just... normal, I suppose.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or finishing their sentences before they have a chance to finish speaking?

I guess... sometimes. I mean, I don't mean to. But... yeah, if my daughter is asking me something, or... or a customer at the counter, or even the trainer at work... I just kind of jump in with an answer before they're done. And then... well, sometimes I realize I didn't actually listen to the whole question, and I answered the wrong thing. So... yeah, I do that.
Do you have a hard time waiting your turn, like when standing in lines or waiting in traffic?

I suppose. I mean... I don't really like waiting. Like if I'm in line at the supplier counter for work, or... or at the clinic. I just get kind of wound up. 

I end up checking the time a lot, or shifting around... just wanting to push things along, I guess. But... yeah. That's about it.
Do you often feel like you are 'on the go,' acting as if you're driven by an internal motor?
I don't really know what that means. I mean... I'm busy, I guess. Between work and everything else, there's always something to do. But I wouldn't say I feel like a motor. Just... busy.
Do people ever tell you that you talk too much, or do you find yourself talking excessively?

I guess so. Sometimes. I mean... if I'm explaining a stain treatment to a customer at the dry cleaners, or... maybe talking to people after choir practice... I just sort of keep going. I can hear myself going on and on. Even when I can see they're kind of... edging toward the door. So, yeah. I guess I do talk a lot sometimes.
Do you often find yourself butting into conversations or taking over tasks that other people are doing without being asked?

I suppose I do. At work, mostly. If the staff are talking, I might... just jump in. Or if I see them sorting the clothes wrong, I just reach over and fix it. I don't really wait for them to ask for help. I know it probably seems like I'm... butting in. But I just do it.
Do you often find yourself getting up from your seat in situations where you are expected to stay seated, such as during meetings, meals, or at work?

Um... yeah, I suppose. Like... at church committee meetings, or... those fabric-care trainings for work. I don't really sit the whole time. I'll... find reasons to get up. To get water, or... grab some papers to check something. Even when everybody else is just sitting still. I just... get up.
